newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle up sharply late on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle up sharply late on fund buying.

text.p: CME April live cattle were sharply higher late on fund buying which accelerated an early advance which had been inspired by Friday's U.S. Department of Agriculture Cattle-on-Feed Report, floor traders said.
At 1358 CST April live cattle stood 0.925 cent higher at 66.850 cents a lb.
The USDA report put December placements on major seven-state feedlots at 98 percent of a year ago compared with an average trade estimate in a Reuter survey of 108.2 percent.
